variables.name: Cluster
variables.input: timeseries n = sum(dt.service.request.count), by: {k8s.cluster.name}, filter: startsWith(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-") | fields k8s.cluster.name | sort k8s.cluster.name asc

variables.name: Namespace
variables.input: timeseries n = sum(dt.service.request.count), by: {k8s.namespace.name}, filter: startsWith(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-") | fields k8s.namespace.name | sort k8s.namespace.name asc

variables.name: Service
variables.input: timeseries n = sum(dt.service.request.count), by: {k8s.workload.name}, filter: startsWith(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-") | fields k8s.workload.name | sort k8s.workload.name asc

1.content:
## QuickCart — service performance across stages
Response time, failure rate and throughput per **stage** (namespace) and **service**. Vertical markers are deployment events from the GitLab pipeline: **blue = deploy**, **red = rollback** (toggle with the *Deployments* filter). Hover a marker for version, author and pipeline.

2.title: Response time p90 (ms) per stage / service
2.query:
timeseries p90 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 90), by: {k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.workload.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd p90_ms = p90[] / 1000
| fieldsRemove p90

3.title: Failure rate (%) per stage / service
3.query:
timeseries {total = sum(dt.service.request.count), failed = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count)}, by: {k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.workload.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd failure_rate_pct = 100 * failed[] / total[]
| fieldsRemove total, failed

4.title: Average response time (ms) per stage / service
4.query:
timeseries avg = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), by: {k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.workload.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd avg_ms = avg[] / 1000
| fieldsRemove avg

5.title: Throughput (requests / min) per stage / service
5.query: timeseries requests_per_min = sum(dt.service.request.count, rate: 1m), by: {k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.workload.name, array($Service))

6.title: Stage comparison (selected timeframe)
6.query:
timeseries {rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), p90 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 90), total = sum(dt.service.request.count), failed = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count)}, by: {k8s.namespace.name, k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.workload.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd avg_ms = arrayAvg(rt) / 1000, p90_ms = arrayAvg(p90) / 1000, requests = arraySum(total), failure_rate_pct = 100 * arraySum(failed) / arraySum(total)
| fields stage = k8s.namespace.name, service = k8s.workload.name, avg_ms, p90_ms, failure_rate_pct, requests
| sort service asc, stage asc

7.title: Deployment log
7.query:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT" and deployment.release_product == "quickcart-demo"
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(service.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd kind = if(endsWith(deployment.name, " rollback"), "rollback", else: "deploy"), stage = replaceString(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-", "")
| filter in(kind, array($Deployments))
| dedup {stage, deployment.version, kind}
| fields time = event.start, stage, kind, version = deployment.version, author = gitlab.merge_request.author, merge_request = gitlab.merge_request.url, pipeline = gitlab.pipeline.url, reason = rollback.reason
| sort time desc

8.content:
## Pipelines (GitLab → OpenTelemetry)
Every pipeline run of the VM's GitLab as a trace: pipeline → stages → jobs. `api` runs are rollbacks started by Dynatrace.

9.title: Pipeline runs
9.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| fields time = start_time, project = service.name, kind = if(gitlab.pipeline.source == "api", "rollback / API", else: gitlab.pipeline.source), result = cicd.pipeline.result, duration_min = round(toDouble(duration) / 60000000000.0, decimals: 1), change = splitString(vcs.ref.head.revision.message, "\n")[0], pipeline = cicd.pipeline.run.url.full
| sort time desc
| limit 50

10.title: Job duration (avg s) and failures
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result)
| summarize avg_s = round(avg(toDouble(duration)) / 1000000000.0, decimals: 0), runs = count(), failed = countIf(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result != "success"), by: {project = service.name, job = span.name}
| sort project asc, avg_s desc

11.title: Pipeline duration (min)
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| makeTimeseries duration_min = max(toDouble(duration) / 60000000000.0), by: {project = service.name}

annotations.name: Deployments
annotations.input:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT" and deployment.release_product == "quickcart-demo"
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(service.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd kind = if(endsWith(deployment.name, " rollback"), "rollback", else: "deploy"), stage = replaceString(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-", "")
| filter in(kind, array($Deployments))
| filter kind == "deploy"
| dedup {stage, deployment.version, kind}
| fields event.start, event.name = concat(stage, " ", kind, " ", deployment.version), event.description = concat(stage, ": ", kind, " ", deployment.version, " by ", coalesce(gitlab.merge_request.author, "pipeline"), " — ", coalesce(gitlab.pipeline.url, ""))

annotations.name: Rollbacks
annotations.input:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT" and deployment.release_product == "quickcart-demo"
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(service.name, array($Service))
| fieldsAdd kind = if(endsWith(deployment.name, " rollback"), "rollback", else: "deploy"), stage = replaceString(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-", "")
| filter in(kind, array($Deployments))
| filter kind == "rollback"
| dedup {stage, deployment.version, kind}
| fields event.start, event.name = concat(stage, " ", kind, " ", deployment.version), event.description = concat(stage, ": ", kind, " ", deployment.version, " by ", coalesce(gitlab.merge_request.author, "pipeline"), " — ", coalesce(gitlab.pipeline.url, ""))
